prompts.link: Create one new icon for Mogging Creator Studio, matching the existing reference set's premium tangible 3D miniature product rendering: charcoal soft-touch material, satin silver metal, cyan accent, rounded substantial forms, subtle realistic fine surface texture and soft studio highlights. Square 1:1 canvas. True transparent alpha background, no white or black background, no checkerboard baked in, no backdrop tile, no floor, no text, no watermark. Centered, icon occupies about 86% of both canvas dimensions with consistent safe padding. Clear silhouette readable as a tiny navigation icon. Near-front view with only subtle depth; not tilted sideways. Subject: exactly two interlocking rounded rectangular chain links forming the universal hyperlink symbol, diagonal lower left to upper right because that orientation makes sense for chain links; one satin silver link and one charcoal link with a narrow tasteful cyan inset accent. Large chunky smooth links with genuinely open transparent centers, physically credible interlocking structure. This is the referral link icon.
